name: @zichan/desktop
description: Tauri 2 desktop shell wrapping the @zichan/web build

scripts.server: npm run server:build && npm run server:run
scripts.server:build: npm run build --workspace @zichan/web && npm run build --workspace @zichan/sync-server
scripts.release:check: npm run server:build && npm run prepare:resources && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
